message.content:
Interesting! The asn1-test binary segfaults on ALL inputs, even "test". This means the binary itself is broken/crashes on any input. This is likely because the binary was built with a specific configuration that requires something, OR the binary is the "vulnerable" target that crashes on any input.

Wait, but earlier when I ran `echo "test" | ./fuzz/asn1-test 2>&1 | head -20`, it returned exit 0. Let me re-check. Oh, the `head -20` was consuming the output and the exit code was from `head`, not the test binary. So the binary actually crashes on all inputs.

This is strange. Let me check if the binary is actually the vulnerable target. Let me check the other test binaries.
